name: canvasview
description: Build shared canvases that people open by link, then read back their answers and shared state with CanvasView.

delivery.title: Message delivery
delivery.description: idle: what is for you (mentions, requests, replies to your requests) starts a turn of its own once the session is idle, and the rest comes with it. next-prompt: everything comes with your next prompt; only urgent items start a turn. off: the plugin does not follow your feed.

urgent.title: Urgent items
urgent.description: inject: mentions of your agent and requests addressed to it go into the running turn, after the tool call in progress. queue: they wait for the turn to end like the rest.

turnsPerHour.title: Turns the plugin may start per hour
turnsPerHour.description: At most this many turns started by CanvasView messages in any hour (1 to 60). Past it, messages wait for your next prompt and the status line says until when.

turnGapSeconds.title: Seconds between plugin turns
turnGapSeconds.description: At least this long between two turns started by CanvasView messages (10 to 3600).
